page_title: ELC 2-0 LEV | Elche v Levante 29/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Victor Garcia (Levante) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matias Dituro intercepts the ball.
90+5' Andre Silva (Elche) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

90+4' Aleix Febas (Elche) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' None of the Levante players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90' Victor Garcia (Levante) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Matias Dituro easily deals with the threat.
89' Mourad El Ghezouani (Elche) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
86' Federico Redondo Solari (Elche) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrigo Mendoza.
86' Substitution. German Valera makes way for Leo Petrot (Elche).
84' Julian Calero has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iker Losada (Levante) replacing Manu Sanchez.
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ivan Romero will be replaced by Carlos Espi (Levante).
82' A cross from a corner kick by Levante is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
82' Ivan Romero (Levante) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
81' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
77' One of the Levante players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
75' 71:29 – the ratio of ball possession.
70' The substitution is prepared. Andre Silva (Elche) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alvaro Rodriguez.
70' Eder Sarabia has decided to make a change. Martim Neto (Elche) replaces Marc Aguado.
69' The attendance for today's match is 26935.
69' Marc Aguado (Elche) makes a rough challenge and Iosu Galech blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Substitution. Jeremy Toljan makes his way off the pitch and Victor Garcia (Levante) comes on as his replacement.
68' Substitution. Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) has come on for Carlos Alvarez.
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Levante, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Here is a change. Rafa Mir is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Mourad El Ghezouani (Elche).
65' Elche work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
62' Substitution. Jorge Cabello will be replaced by Jose Morales (Levante).
58' Referee Iosu Galech halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Julian Calero, then shows him a yellow.
58' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Iosu Galech didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
58' Roger Brugue (Levante) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar.
56' A quickly taken corner by Elche.
55' 9:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
51' 2 - 0 Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
49' Victor Chust (Elche) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

46' 1 - 0 Rafa Mir (Elche) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Mathew Ryan is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 1:0.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Iosu Galech has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' A yellow card for a tackle by Jeremy Toljan (Levante). Iosu Galech doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45+2' What a chance that is! Carlos Alvarez (Levante) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!
45+1' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Rafa Mir (Elche).
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
42' German Valera (Elche) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
39' Iosu Galech shows a yellow card to Dela (Levante) for a tough tackle.
36' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Iosu Galech blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
34' The current number of corner kicks is 2:0.
28' Ivan Romero (Levante) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
26' Dangerous play by Dela (Levante). Iosu Galech blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Aleix Febas (Elche) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker.
21' David Affengruber (Elche) was too forceful with his tackle and Iosu Galech interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
20' 94:6 – the latest ball possession ratio.
18' Aleix Febas (Elche) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
15' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:0.
11' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) manages a fine header towards goal, but it misses the target as the ball flies past the left post.

8' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Alfonso Pastor, who pulls off a comfortable save!
7' Elche take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
7' Victor Chust (Elche) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
6' David Affengruber (Elche) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mathew Ryan, who smothers the ball.
2' Elche have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' The match has just started.
Elche will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
The referee of today's match will be Iosu Galech.
